about: The article of law that gives a court its say in a step of a case: by the tier of the court, the procedure the metadata names (psi:procedure, its start) and the area of law (dc:subject). Read by core/judgment_course.py. Kept by hand from the text of the laws; a step none of them fits has no basis (a gap), never a guessed one. A rule with after_tier hears only the judgments of that court: cassation in bestuur only against the Centrale Raad van Beroep, leapfrog cassation (sprongcassatie) against the rechtbank, the gerechtshof after the Hoge Raad sent a case to it (procedure Verwijzing na Hoge Raad). A designation with after_tier belongs to the step of that after_tier only; one without it to each step of its tier, procedure and area. The other articles that give the court its say in a step of the route, by tier, procedure and area, are under designations (the route, not a step of the Verloop): the article of the Bevoegdheidsregeling bestuursrechtspraak (Awb bijlage 2) that names a court, the Awb beside the RO in tax cases, the laws that open cassation against the Centrale Raad van Beroep (those read, not all there may be), the Rv beside the RO in leapfrog cassation. Known gaps, not read in the source: under gaps.
